attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors; paraphrased pinned Hopper article.
source_behavior: Normal Hopper hops randomly until the player is nearby, then pursues. It can cross rocks and gaps.
Flaming Hopper also wanders outside detection range; its detection radius, hop length and hop speed are greater.
The source describes a 60% normal-to-Flaming replacement in Burning Basement; this distinct stage-variant rule remains unfinished.
stage_evidence: docs/research/isaac-enemy-port-plan.json: positive-weight authored room occurrences for both forms in Basement/Caves/Depths-equivalent bands 0–2.
adaptations: Normal range 6, wander/chase distances 2/4, flight .7s, base/max apex 1.4/5; Flaming range 11, distances 3/6, flight .5s, apex 1.8/6. All dimensions/timing are local DeathWard tuning.
Existing 2.4/.55 and 1.6/.45 recovery/windup values retained. Hostile flight duration includes the existing 1.1 movement multiplier.

Swept 3D arc uses actual hitbox height, raises the arc only as needed within its cap, and requires legal ground at the destination. Interior cover/water is traversable; enclosing cliffs/gates/room bounds remain solid.
Bounded shorter/lateral candidates handle unavailable landings. Target position is committed before takeoff and revalidated at launch.
Stun and compatible fire transformation finish committed flight; the new form uses its own parameters on its next jump. Room re-entry preserves progress.
Normal pursuit specialist cost 2/cap 2; Flaming cost 3/cap 1; both weight 1 in bands 0–2. These are local budgets, not source spawn probabilities.
limitations: Exact native timing, hop physics, damage conversion and champion/item/status interactions are not fully verified.
Real solid geometry is checked before takeoff. Runtime insertion of new solid obstacles during flight is not supported by this controller; ordinary expedition demolition removes obstacles.
Burning Basement 60% replacement and complete fire item producers/status system remain unfinished.
Ground-gap fixture proves collision behavior, not a claim that every generated river is jumpable. Complete mixed-room/floor balance, all-angle visuals and controlled performance remain open.
